subject: lucky-hammer
q: CLOSED BY SIERRA — it was Megan, and she said so herself.
detail:
The Archive recorded the bar, the stool, Sera going quiet, and the Arc 12 dating that made it possible — and refused at every step to assert it. IT DID NOT HAVE TO. SIERRA SAID THE NAME AT THE TABLE, unprompted, in her own time, after nobody asked.

EIGHT MONTHS. AND SIERRA TOPS. Megan comes to her, on Sierra's schedule, and is very good about being told when — a woman who had been getting through as many as nine a night without one of them ever giving her an instruction, which turns out to have been the only thing she was actually after.

AND THE UNIVERSE RANG HER PHONE about four seconds after the name landed. What Sierra said into it, in a full kitchen, without lowering her voice: YOU'RE SUCH A GOOD GIRL FOR NOT LETTING SOMEONE USE THAT ASS, BABY. I'M VISITING FRIENDS, BUT WILL BE FREE SOON.

THE TATTOO IS THE RECORD OF THE FIRST NIGHT — readable only by somebody already looking down at her, which on the evidence is where Megan has spent a good deal of the last eight months.

METHOD NOTE, KEPT ON PURPOSE: the Archive was right about every component and still declined to file the conclusion, and it cost nothing, because the woman who owned the fact volunteered it within the hour. THAT IS WHAT WAITING IS FOR.
